page: Amazon Web Services r9gd.8xlarge is a memory-optimized instance built on the AWS Nitro System and powered by the 64-bit ARM-based AWS Graviton processor architecture. The configuration supplies 32 physical cores running 32 vCPUs at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz, with a dedicated 1:1 physical-to-virtual CPU thread mapping. It is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. Networking throughput features a baseline capacity of 17 Gbps, with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses assigned.

Local ephemeral storage is provided via 1900 GB of bundled NVMe SSD instance storage. This direct NVMe attachment enables high-throughput, low-latency disk operations alongside the memory capacity. There are no discrete hardware accelerators included, establishing the instance as a compute-dense, memory-heavy platform with localized solid-state capacity rather than a GPU compute node.

From an infrastructure perspective, the ARM64 Graviton architecture paired with dedicated per-core hardware threads delivers predictable performance without hyperthreading contention. The high memory density combined with integrated high-speed local NVMe storage reduces external block storage latency dependencies. This hardware profile is suited for memory-intensive workloads requiring rapid local cache or scratch space, including distributed in-memory caching layers, relational databases, big data analytics, and real-time operational datastores.
